news.title: Lebanon strikes by Israel test US-Iran deal as peace talks postponed
news.summary: Renewed fighting between Israel and the Iranian-backed militia group Hezbollah is testing a preliminary deal between the U.S. and Iran to begin nuclear talks and avoid a return to all out war.
